plan.title: eRFX RFQ Invite Mapped and Named Vendor

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Configure the project with an RFQ stage only.
Move to the RFQ stage before configuring its template and items.
Apply the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10; the catalog cannot choose the specific variant or delivery location.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.
Invite all product-mapped vendors and add the specifically named Vendor C; the product flow handles duplicate membership.
Verify that publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published RFQ stage's Participants list.
Verify that Vendor C is listed as a selected participant after publishing.
Verify that the published stage contains participants, while the exact dynamic mapped-vendor count cannot be asserted without a stated roster.
